_comment: Installed nature family with the existing Meadows green leaf replacement: the source twisted-tree texture is crimson and cannot become green through multiplication. Baked route and grove composition; no runtime world generation. storm_mushroom is the installed ground dome Mushroom_Common (WO-F09-05 round 2: the Laetiporus bracket shelf grows on trunks and read as fungus floating in the grass when planted loose).

encounter_clearings._comment: Named fights keep trunk and rock colliders out of their arena: 18 m covers the largest named wildlife envelope (voltarach 13.89 m: fitted body, idle motion, wander) plus the largest baked collider reach (crown_canopy 0.435 m x 6.0) and 1.5 m margin. tests/test_stormwood_named_fight_clearings.gd checks the bake against each species.
encounter_clearings._why_19_5: F41 candidate: the Meshy giant_canopy collider reaches 0.14 x 28 = 3.92 m, beyond crown_canopy 0.435 x 6.0; 13.89 + 3.92 + 1.5 = 19.31, rounded up.

seat_clearings._comment: Authored seats keep baked colliders off them: no trunk or rock surface (collision_radius x the layer's scale_max) within collider_surface_m of a trainer, NPC, harvest node or pickup position, and no ground cover centred within ground_cover_m. Seats are read from stormwood_trainers/npcs/harvests/pickups.json; only their kind, id and XZ position enter the bake fingerprint. tests/test_stormwood_scatter_clearances.gd checks the committed bake.

_comment_dense_stands: F10#4 round 7 (strict re-check: off-road Deepwood read as the edge of a wood; tools/_probe_deepwood_sightlines.gd measured a median first trunk 56-107 m away at eye level with up to 9 of 21 rays open past 120 m): the three Deepwood stands go from 17 m to 12 m spacing (skip 0.15/0.2 -> 0.1/0.15), a median first trunk of 26-27 m with 1 of 21 rays open past 120 m. 12 m stays above the 9 m tree occupancy cell. F10#4 forest (code-blind judge round 1, V-VIS-1): Deepwood read as an open flower meadow because the background grid plants one tree per background_spacing_m cell. Each dense stand fills its circle on a finer jittered grid (spacing_m, 40% jitter, skip fraction) with its own seed, after the roads and the background grid and through the same clearances (roads, settlements, landmarks, seats, pockets, fight clearings), with understory ferns/mushrooms round an `understory` fraction of the trunks.

dense_stands._comment: F41 round-10 candidate: Ash Road walks through storm forest (art direction: little direct sky until the aftermath); road, rod line and seats stay clear via the bake's own clearances.
F41 round-10 candidate: the Glowmoss Hollows ringed by old storm wood.

giant_canopy._comment: F41 round-4 candidate: reference-backed Meshy giant storm trees (assets/props/meshy-1020/giant_tree_a|b/provenance.json), native ~1.9 units, scale 23-28 for 44-53 m; trunk radius 0.14 native (~3.5 m). Placement, harvest and clearances unchanged.

storm_deadwood._comment: F41 round-7 candidate: Meshy lightning-scarred split trunk, native ~1.9 units, 13-17 m; trunk radius 0.13 native.

storm_mushroom._comment: F41 round-7 candidate: Meshy storm fungi (cyan-violet caps on mossy stumps), native ~1.9 units, 1.5-2.7 m.
